items.title: Popover
items.description: Non-modal popover on Base UI Popover: panel in a portal, positioned by Base UI, Escape and outside press dismiss, focus returns to the trigger. Title and description are linked to the dialog.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverTitle, PopoverDescription, PopoverClose. Pass `modal={false}` for a non-trapping popover. Positioning uses Base UI's Positioner (side, align, sideOffset), not CSS anchor positioning. Popup uses yorha-pop (scale+opacity from --transform-origin); optional PopoverArrow and PopoverBackdrop (yorha-fade) parts. Reduced motion is opacity-only, off is instant.
